thread:
marie.csm: Heads-up — saw 3 midmarket accounts flagged by Health 2.0 for low API usage and stalled onboarding (trial > 21d). I want to try a light-touch intervention play to prevent churn. Drafting steps here so we can action quickly.

ashley.csm: +1. can you drop the proposed steps? happy to take outreach.

marie.csm: Proposal: 1) 48h automated nudge with a tailored checklist link; 2) human touch within 72h — a 20-min enablement session offer (calendar link); 3) in-app micro-tips (3 cards over 7 days) for quick wins; 4) escalation rule: if still no engagement by day 14, present a soft downgrade credit + re-activation roadmap and offer a high-touch onboarding slot. Keep wording standard for low-touch midmarket so CSMs can spin it up fast.

sam_eng: I can implement the automation and webhook. need: checklist URL + calendar pool + email templates. I can reuse the onboard-quickstart flow; ETA EOD.

priya_ps: I'll write the 20-min enablement script and 1-slide playbook for CSMs. also adding a 2-question feedback capture: "what blocked you from getting to production?" + "what would help you ship in 7 days?" — funnel those answers into Gainsight notes.

marie.csm: checklist: https://redwood.com/onboarding/checklist-midmarket
calendar pool: https://cal.com/redwood/cs-20min (team slot = cs-short). Email templates: i'll paste short copy in the doc later.

ashley.csm: I'll run the list: BeaconRetail, NovaPay, HelixLabs. BeaconRetail also has a billing tag; HelixLabs has a failed key rotation (ticket #8742). NovaPay just dropped token usage after initial POC.

sam_eng: noted. I'll wire automation to: POST /hooks/cs-alerts when replies contain keywords ("billing","key rotation","invoice"). payload: acct, thread_ts, snippet. I'll test with BeaconRetail tomorrow and enable dry-run.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled — automation 'light-touch-activation-revival' queued for 2025-04-10 16:00 UTC.

ashley.csm: quick Q — for downgrade credit, is there an approved amount bracket for midmarket? dont want to promise incorrectly.

marie.csm: Keep it standard: one month credit up to $1k for accounts under $10k ARR; escalate >$10k to AM. We should log approvals in the ticket.

priya_ps: adding the enablement slide: 3 bullets (1. quick API test, 2. sample prompt + metrics, 3. validate key rotation). will add a tiny checklist for the 20-min call.

sam_eng: automation draft pushed to staging. webhook test passed for sample 'billing' reply. I'll set a toggle so we can enable/disable per-customer cohort.

marie.csm: assigning actions: Sam -> automation + webhook go-live; Priya -> enablement slide + survey; Ashley -> outreach + first-touch emails for the three accounts; I'll coordinate follow-ups and update the renewal risk tag if no engagement after 14 days. Please add quick reactions when done. :thumbsup:

ashley.csm: ack, starting outreach now.

priya_ps: will drop slides + survey link by 10:30 PT.

sam_eng: enabling live toggle now. will ping when the automation toggles on.

marie.csm: thanks team — let's try this pattern for the next 20 flagged accounts and iterate. keeping notes here for the playbook.
